profile_text: With a focus on wholesale and retail trade, as well as repair of motor vehicles and motorcycles, this Düsseldorf-based company has established itself as a top performer, with 17 employees as of 2024. A growth rate of 70% since the baseline indicates a strong upward trajectory, driven by its specialized services in the automotive sector. As one of the 451 top companies in Düsseldorf, it has solidified its position in the market, earning recognition from industry trackers like DDW.
